run_remote_hello_realsense_server: run the Pyro4 server for RemoteHelloRealsense on a given IP with optional ROS support
get_rgb_depth_frames: get rotated RGB and depth image frames from the RealSense camera with optional compression
get_open3d_point_cloud: create an Open3D point cloud from RGB-D frames using camera transform and base state
check_obstacle_in_front: check if there is an obstacle in front of the robot using point cloud and LiDAR data
calibrate_camera_tilt: calibrate the camera tilt angle using plane segmentation on a captured point cloud
